name: devns
description: Local-first harness for long-running agent work with feature JSON, verification gates, review packets, and HTML review.

interface.shortDescription: Run agent work through a feature JSON harness.
interface.longDescription: DEVNS helps Codex initialize a local harness, clarify features into RFCs, claim exactly one approved feature, run verification lanes, record evidence/history, and produce review packets for humans and read-only review agents.
defaultPrompt: Use DEVNS to check project status and continue one feature.
Initialize DEVNS and discover candidate features.
Clarify a DEVNS feature into an approved RFC.
